''See also: [[Archstone Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Archstone is a scripted, smoky crystal artifact that functions by siphoning power from its surroundings. It possesses a [[hunger]] for spirits and can draw [[madra]] from targets, though the amount it extracts may depend on the power level or consciousness of those nearby. While capable of siphoning significant energy, its use is limited by the capacity and stability of the wielder; for instance, excessive use can erode a person's soul foundation or shatter their core. In one instance, the [[stone]] was used to swell an [[Underlord's Remnant]], making it powerful enough that multiple individuals would have been required to contain the resulting [[spirit]]. Historically, the Archstone is considered a treasure from a [[labyrinth]] located in the western reaches of the empire. Its retrieval by [[Jai Daishou]] was viewed as a dangerous violation of imperial commands, as such actions risked attracting the attention of the [[Dreadgods]]. The artifact can be stored within a person's [[soulspace]], appearing as a clear object floating among their [[madra channels]]. It can also be used to reinforce physical augmentations; when [[Lindon]] used the [[stone]] to flood his [[Lindon's skeletal Remnant arm|Remnant arm]] with power, it altered and strengthened his [[binding]] [[technique]] before the [[stone]] itself shattered from the intensity of the energy transfer.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Archstone is a [[Lord]] treasure in the form of a [[crystal ball]] that was retrieved from a [[western labyrinth]] by [[Jai Daishou]]. This powerful artifact serves as an option for [[Jai Daishou]], possessing the capability to siphon vast amounts of [[madra]] from everyone present in a room. When in use, the object can cause the surrounding world to appear lifeless and gray.}}
